freeze_corrections: Provisional first freeze visually misassigned some vowel orders, possessive spellings and endings, and conflated the visually distinct two tree plurals. After controls: Gannat ends Taw VI, demonstrative Taw II, first tree Waw VI versus second I, first great Yaman IV with Nun I, second IV with Nun VI, beauty has ሥናሙ, repeated much is singular ብዙኅ, the gerund is በሊዖሙ, and knowing has final ዋ. The prior root first great ወዐቢይነ changes to directly observed ወዐቢያነ.
controls_limit: Dillmann 824 attests an explicitly doubtful head, not a secure sense. The actual Charles edition word is retained; no 1851/Flemming/German/Aramaic adoption. Both stars retained, no daggers/brackets inside Charles body of numbered 3. The translation bracket is modern explanatory uncertainty, not a claimed source break.
discriminating_evidence_if_meaning_neede: A close parallel with identifiable context or a securely preserved matching Aramaic clause, plus expert Ethiopic analysis of the construction, would discriminate competing spatial/variety/other hypotheses. A new scan alone or unmarked reconstruction would not.
